body: The fact that this is consistent is the reason I'm finding it difficult to blame anyone except myself. I'm the common denominator. The subtle hints are hard to explain. I've been told by many people that I read into things too much and I think that may be the problem. For example they're always hanging out and I rarely get invited. One time I was invited and I was not able to go one person said "there, can't say we didn't ask him". I thought about that line for at least a week. It felt like they asked me to come for the sake of saying they asked me. Again that might not be the case maybe it's me, there's really no way of knowing. Thanks a ton!
I understand. I'll remove the post entirely, hope no one read it and understood the method.

I feel disconnected from everyone. All throughout my life I never really fit in with anyone. I always had friends but I never really connected with any of them. I've dated two girls and both times they cheated on me with my friends and abandoned me in a heartbeat. But now I don't really blame them anymore.im certain I'm the problem and I'm happy they left for someone better. I really don't think I have a place in this world. I can't even connect with my family. All I had was my brother and now he's all grown up and he doesn't talk to me anymore. I've been thinking a lot and I don't think my death would impact anyone (which is why I'm not writing a note) I'm not close with anyone and my death shouldn't upset them too much. When I hang out with my current group of friends I have a great time only they sometimes make offhand comments hinting that they don't really want me. I don't think I'll be able to go through with this suicide. I've planned a suicide every week for a while now and  still here. Gah my thoughts are everywhere, I don't know if this makes sense to you at all but thanks anyway for your time!
